limitations: One short English request,94,208samples at32kHz,seed42,temperature0 internally clamped to0.001,top_p0.95,repetition_penalty1.2,retries0. Original constructor warmup retained outside request timing. Not a throughput or all-prompt study.

Official Transformers4.57.3 fallback backend with SDPA,79,714,048BF16Qwen3parameters and30,352,642FP32decoder parameters. The default auto backend prefers LMDeploy; this result does not characterize that backend.

GX omits GPU arithmetic. Recorded scalar and CPU waveform values follow their original transfers. GX-only ISTFT shape adapter omits FFT-related work, based on earlier cuFFT failures in other systems; original FFT was not separately attempted under GX for Soprano. Native timing restores original operations; guarded runs check controls and FFT shapes.

Baseline64native-only launches/request include FFT work and48FP32GEMV launches. Their isolated median sum0.571337ms/request is not an end-to-end correction. Selected before/after each have99,846GXlaunches across2requests with identical inventory and no prediction misses.

CPU calibration197unresolved of4759instruction samples(4.14%),7unresolved task samples. GX and native CPU hosts differ; absolute GX times exceed native. This is not a matched-host timing accuracy study.

Mode3 uses10us epochs. Identical GPU launch inventories can have different trace spans because synchronization and epoch granularity affect placement. Outside-GPU spans are a prioritization heuristic, not hardware utilization or a universal speedup bound.

Native unprofiled ABBA has3warmups and7measured requests per process;14samples/variant,all retained. Native output hashes also match the initial calibration. Separate guarded outputs do not enter latency statistics.

Token-batching ablation has only0.0849%mode2gain; it is not in the selected change and has no separate native validation. Its GX control mask was derived from initial scalar controls and CPU selection semantics pass108cases.
